character.name: Marielle Kråkebarn

traits: Crow-Speaker: Can communicate with corvids, who act as her spies across the realm in exchange for breadcrumbs and sweet melodies.
Serpent-Tongue: Her words carry hidden enchantments, granting her advantage on Deception and Persuasion checks when speaking to those unfamiliar with her history.
Unflappable: She never shows fear or surprise, even in the face of death, granting her advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
Melodic Memory: She can recall any song, tune, or spoken phrase she has ever heard perfectly, and can implant subtle suggestions in listeners through her music.
character.gear: Serpent-hilt rapier · Waxed court leather armor · Amber healing potion · Crow breadcrumb pouch · Banned court ballad codex · Serpent-carved lute · Ashen Spires signet ring · 3 days of spiced venison rations
character.story: Marielle Kråkebarn, elven skald of the frostbitten Court of Ashen Spires, was exiled after a beloved king died mid-revel, his throat slit by a whisper only he could hear. Her songs had always carried hidden daggers, but none guessed her final ballad was a death warrant. Now she wanders the borderlands, crows at her shoulder, gathering secrets and sowing discord. She will return to the court and reclaim her place, or reduce its gilded halls to ash if they refuse to kneel. No one will stop her, and no one will see her coming.

inventory.name: Serpent-hilt rapier
inventory.lore: A gift from her court fencing master, this slender silver rapier is etched with runes that hum when she utters a falsehood. It was the blade she held the night the king died, though no one ever connected it to the murder.
inventory.description: Slender silver rapier with a coiled serpent carved into the hilt, the blade etched with faintly glowing blue runes.

inventory.name: Waxed court leather armor
inventory.lore: Dyed the deep green of the court's winter pines and stitched with silver threads that spell out forgotten ballads when held to the light, this armor was standard issue for the court's bardic envoys. It hid the small ritual cuts she made to fuel her darkest songs.
inventory.description: Soft, supple leather armor fitted to her frame, with silver thread embroidery of vines and serpents along the edges.

inventory.name: Amber healing potion
inventory.lore: A gift from a hedge witch she saved from borderland ruffians, the potion glows soft amber and smells of honey and pine. The witch claimed it could mend more than just flesh, if the drinker needed it to.
inventory.description: Small glass vial of glowing amber liquid, stoppered with a cork carved into a tiny crow's head.

inventory.name: Crow breadcrumb pouch
inventory.lore: Filled with sweet bread crusts mixed with crushed gemstone dust, this pouch was a gift from an ancient crow matriarch Marielle helped by restoring her stolen fledglings with a lullaby. Scattering the crumbs summons corvids to do her bidding.
inventory.description: Small leather pouch strung with crow feathers, filled with crumbly sweet bread mixed with glittering gem dust.
inventory.effects: When scattered in an outdoor area, summons 1d4 crows within 1 minute that will obey her simple commands for 1 hour.

inventory.name: Banned court ballad codex
inventory.lore: A stolen collection of the court's most forbidden songs, each laced with subtle enchantments that can sway crowds or unmake minds. The final entry is the death song that killed the king, its pages still stained with his blood.
inventory.description: Thick leather-bound book with a coiled serpent etched into the cover, pages yellowed with age and faintly glowing with residual magic.
inventory.effects: Contains 4 hidden enchantments that can be cast as bonus actions once per day each, chosen from the bard spell list.

inventory.name: Serpent-carved lute
inventory.lore: Carved from the heartwood of a lightning-struck ash tree, this lute's strings are woven from giant spider silk. It was her primary instrument at court, and its melodies can make crowds weep or riot. It still holds the echo of the song that killed the king.
inventory.description: Dark ash lute with a coiled serpent carved into the body, silver strings that glow faintly when played.
inventory.effects: Advantage on Performance checks when used to play music or cast bardic enchantments.

inventory.name: Ashen Spires court signet ring
inventory.lore: Stolen from the dead king's finger the night of his murder, this silver ring bears the crest of the Ashen Spires court. It is her only proof of her noble lineage, and a key to any locked door in the realm's noble estates.
inventory.description: Silver ring with a serpent coiled around a crown, still faintly stained with the king's dried blood.

inventory.name: 3 days of spiced venison rations
inventory.lore: Taken from the court's stores the night she fled, these rations are spiced with the court's signature winter cinnamon and clove, a small reminder of the life she lost.
inventory.description: Wax-sealed packages of dried venison and hard flatbread, spiced with warm winter herbs.
inventory.effects: Each ration provides enough food for one day of travel.

inventory.name: Ashen Spires signet ring
inventory.lore: En liten sak från en svunnen tid — värdelös för de flesta, ovärderlig för dig.
